description_en: Queries one or more container clusters that meet the specified conditions
description_zh: 查询符合条件的一个或多个容器集群
kebab_example: aliyun hbr describe-container-cluster --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --cluster-id cc-00000000000000000hg9 --identifier cca00000000000000000000000000087a --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeContainerCluster

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页页码，从1开始，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 99. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，最小值为1，最大值为99，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the container cluster. For a Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK) cluster, specify the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh: 容器集群标识符，对于阿里云容器服务Kubernetes集群，该参数指Kubernetes集群ID
parameters.name: identifier
